It's awesome. I've been playing it for the past 3-4 hours and would highly recommend it.

It's a *very* fast-paced platformer/vertical scrolling game. You drop down a well and fight a bunch of enemies with "gun boots", which slow you down every time you shoot. Some enemies can be killed by landing on top of them, some of them can't, and all of them move in different ways so you have to learn their patterns. Kill combos can be chained to get treasure which you spend at the shop to buy life or different upgrades, but you lose your combo every time you hit the floor, so you have to try and freefall whilst killing enemies for as long as possible for bigger combo bonuses. Combos carry over into the next level if you're midway through one when you reach the end. Different "styles" can be unlocked, which change the character you're playing as so you have more/less health, fall slower/faster etc. There are different weapon pickups and you have a choice of random powerups to choose from each time you complete a level.

Overall it is very well made, the art style is great and you unlock several different colour themes depending on how much treasure you collect. I imagine there is potential for people to get extremely frustrated whilst playing it because it is pretty hard, I haven't made it past the third level yet.

It's only [$2 on Steam at the moment](http://store.steampowered.com/app/360740/), definitely worth it. If you're a fan of Super Meat Boy or N++ then you'll probably enjoy it.
